## Appearance

Anne is a tall, slender girl with a pointed freckled face, large solemn gray eyes, and auburn hair. Formerly kept in long braids, her bright hair was briefly cropped into short, silky curls after a mishap with green dye, but she later wears it in a heavy braid wound around her shapely head. In her earlier years, she was self-conscious about her skinny limbs, abundant freckles, and vivid red hair.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P55](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0055), [v1 c9 P13](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0013), [v1 c10 P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v1 c13 P1](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0001), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c27 P36](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0036), [v1 c28 P6](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0006), [v1 c29 P18](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0018), [v1 c31 P16](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0016), [v1 c37 P32](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0032)_

## Personality

Highly imaginative, passionate, and prone to daydreaming, Anne often gets carried away by her inner romantic visions. She is intensely loyal and affectionate toward her friends, yet she possesses a fierce, stubborn temper and can hold long-standing grudges when deeply insulted. Though impulsive and heedless in her childhood, she is bright, hardworking, and deeply ambitious, always striving to excel academically and prove herself worthy of her loved ones' pride.

_Sources: [v1 c4 P20](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0020), [v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c19 P62](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0062), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c32 P34](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0034), [v1 c34 P27](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0027)_

## History

Anne Shirley arrives in Avonlea after being sent from an orphan asylum to Green Gables, where siblings Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert originally intended to adopt a boy to help on the farm. Impressed by her spirit and imagination, they decide to keep her. Anne quickly swears a solemn oath of eternal friendship with her neighbor Diana Barry, though her explosive temper causes an early clash with Rachel Lynde. At Avonlea school, she develops a fierce academic rivalry and deep grudge against Gilbert Blythe after he calls her 'Carrots.' Over the years, Anne's quick mind and dramatic nature lead to various mishaps, including accidentally intoxicating Diana with currant wine, breaking her ankle walking a roof ridgepole, accidentally flavoring a cake with anodyne liniment, and accidentally dying her hair green. However, she earns the lifelong gratitude of the Barry family by saving Diana's sister Minnie May during a bout of croup. She joins the Queen's Academy preparation class under Miss Stacy's guidance, ties with Gilbert for first place on the Island Entrance examinations, and later wins the prestigious Avery Scholarship at Queen's Academy. Following Matthew's sudden death, Anne decides to forego attending Redmond College to remain at Green Gables and support Marilla, accepting a position as the local schoolteacher in Avonlea.

## Background by volume

- born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia to Walter and Bertha Shirley  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
- orphaned in infancy and raised in turn by Mrs. Thomas and Mrs. Hammond  <sub>[v1 c7 P12](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0012), [v1 c8 P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043)</sub>
